content.value: For the systems described by the following expressions, with x(t) input and y(t) 10 output, determine which are causal and which are non-causal. (i) $\mathbf { y ( t ) } = \mathbf { x ( t - } 2 )$ (ii) ${ \bf y } ( { \sf t } ) = { \bf x } ( - { \sf t } )$ (iii) $\mathrm { y ( t ) } = \mathrm { x ( a t ) } ; \mathrm { a } { > } 1$ (iv) $\mathbf { y } ( \mathrm { t } ) = \mathbf { x } ( \mathrm { a t } ) ; \mathrm { a } { < } 1$
